in_sanskrit.name: नीलेश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has a dark blue complexion.

in_marathi.name: Neelesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Neelesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘nil’ meaning blue and ‘asya’ meaning lotus. The name Neelesh signifies the one who is calm, composed and has a deep connection with nature, especially the lotus. This name is often given to boys who are born during the rainy season or those who are believed to have a deep spiritual connection.
